relevance_note: Narrative review of paediatric Behçet's disease that mentions A20 haploinsufficiency only at study or disease level (e.g. 'Zhou et al. [13] reported on five families of different ethnicities with autosomal dominant, high-penetrance mutations in TNFAIP3') and gives no patient-level genotype or clinical detail ('No new data were created or analyzed in this study').
method_note: Read the whole Markdown file manually (body, Tables 1-3, references); no script transcribed any table. Every mention of A20 haploinsufficiency/TNFAIP3 is study-level or disease-level: section 3.2 summarises a 16-patient HA20 study [41] and the Papadopoulou et al. monogenic-mimic cohort [33] only with aggregate statements; section 7.1.1 summarises Zhou et al. [13] (five families, no per-person data), a WES study in familial BD [89], and 'a patient treated for longstanding intestinal BD-like symptoms was later diagnosed with A20 haploinsufficiency [91]' (one sentence: no variant, sex, age or other per-person detail); Table 3 marks features as present/absent for the disease HA20 as a whole, not for any person. No variant string (c., p., g. or transcript) appears anywhere in the paper. Because no person is described with genotype or individual clinical detail, the individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist tables are left empty; the single-sentence case [91] was deliberately not made into an individual row (flagged for the reviewer). n_patients_reported is null because the authors give no count of patients described in this document (the 16 and 'five families' figures belong to cited studies). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null because the review has no patients of its own and makes no such statement. No contradictions concerning individuals were found.
